title: Obyekt olmoshlari: me, him, her, us, them
can_do: Kim haqida gapirayotganingizni olmosh bilan ko'rsatasiz
why: «Men uni kecha ko'rdim» deyish uchun him yoki her kerak. Bu kichik jadval bo'lmasa, gap tugallanmay qoladi: I saw … va tamom.

points.text: Har bir ega olmoshining obyekt shakli bor: I → me, you → you, he → him, she → her, it → it, we → us, they → them.

examples.en: She called us in the evening.

points.text: Obyekt shakli fe'ldan keyin ham, predlogdan keyin ham keladi: I saw him, with them, for me, to her.

examples.en: I went to the market with them.

points.text: O'zbek tilida bu ma'no qo'shimcha bilan beriladi — «meni», «unga» — shuning uchun ingliz tilida alohida so'z tushib qoladi: I saw deyilib, kim ko'rilgani aytilmaydi.

examples.en: I met her at the bus stop.

points.text: Tartib ikkita: give me the book yoki give the book to me. «Give to me the book» degan uchinchi shakl yo'q.

examples.en: Give me your phone number, please.
I sent the photos to them.

points.text: Tell va ask fe'llari predlog olmaydi: tell me, ask him — «tell to me» xato.

examples.en: She told me about the party.

common_errors.why: Fe'ldan keyin ega shakli emas, obyekt shakli keladi: he → him.

common_errors.wrong: She told to me about it.
common_errors.why: Tell fe'li predlog olmaydi: told me, told him.
Tartib: fe'l → obyekt → narsa. Predlog faqat «give the book to me» shaklida kerak.
Predlogdan keyin har doim obyekt shakli keladi: between — predlog.

common_errors.wrong: I met she at the station.
common_errors.right: I met her at the station.
common_errors.why: She → her. Bu xato «u» so'zi o'zbek tilida bitta bo'lgani uchun ko'p uchraydi.

words.example: I saw him at the stadium.
We met her in the park.
She wrote to me two days ago.

practice_spec.note: Mashqlarni AI shu spetsifikatsiya bo'yicha yaratadi. Tur raqamlari — docs/mashqlar.md dagi shkala.

items.focus: otni olmosh bilan almashtirish: I saw Aziz → I saw him
«saw he», «told to me», «between you and I» xatolarini topish
o'zbekchadan tarjima: «Men uni kecha ko'rdim», «Ular bizga aytdi»

final.task: Bitta rasm haqida hikoya yozing: kim bor edi va ular bilan nima qildingiz. Kamida to'rtta obyekt olmoshi ishlating.

skill_task.task: Telefoningizdagi bitta rasm haqida baland ovozda gapiring: kim bor, u bilan nima qildingiz. Uchta obyekt olmoshi ishlating.
